slice: harness: .claude/ (agents, skills, hooks, workflows, watchdog, settings) + vscode-agent-env/ (Perdix extension) + claude-serena-watchdog*.ps1
summary: This slice is the Claude-side operator harness, not part of the Daedalus runtime: 21 subagent charters, 7 repo skills + 1 user-level skill, 2 project hooks plus 5 Iron-Plan hook bindings in the project settings file, 2 JS workflow scripts (ship/audit), an owner-run PowerShell watchdog for 48h autonomous runs, and the VS Code cockpit. Per the plan's authority table these are a 'derived projection' (load the plan, report drift, block ordinary mutation) and are explicitly NOT a security boundary (plan section 1) - the harness is honest about that in serena-first.py's docstring. Health is good: everything except the watchdog runtime state is tracked, the extension is held to its manifest by two real test modules, and the one dead webview template is labelled and pinned by a test rather than believed. The weak spots are runtime residue leaking into a protected directory (.claude/watchdog/ untracked and not ignored), owner-machine absolute paths hardcoded in the watchdog launcher, and the fact that the extension still drives the legacy daedalus.cli/file_bridge surface rather than a Gate-0 canonical entrypoint.

integration_gaps: .claude/watchdog/ is untracked AND unignored (git status: `?? .claude/watchdog/`; git check-ignore matches only the scheduled-task lock via .git/info/exclude:8) - watchdog run receipts and a Serena system-prompt dump are one `git add -A` from landing inside a protected policy directory. Either ignore it or move run state under runs/.

The VS Code extension is an effectful entrypoint outside the canonical guard path: extension.js:117 spawns `python -m daedalus.cli web` and :514 `python -m daedalus.file_bridge watch` with only a UI confirm dialog between the user and unbounded Claude spend. Gate 0 requires a centralized start/guard path for every effectful runtime entrypoint.

Two agent generations coexist with no router between them: the Ikarus-crew role charters (core-dev/safety-dev/test-dev/extension-dev/orchestration-dev) and the Athena worker group (heracles/atalanta/odysseus/penelope/hephaestus). .claude/workflows/ship.js:22 only knows the older set, so the workers are unreachable from the encoded ship sequence.

The `room` skill (~/.claude/skills/room/) is user-level only while its state file (runs/council/room.md, currently modified) lives in the repo. The repo carries the transcript but not the instrument that writes it - a clone cannot reproduce a room session.

MCP_TIMEOUT=120000, the measured fix for the Serena cold-start race, exists only in the untracked local settings overlay; a fresh checkout silently reintroduces the race that makes the serena-first hook fail open.

.claude/proposals/ (statusline + PreCompact vault marker + Notification toast) is a deliberate island awaiting one owner decision; it has been pending since 2026-08-17 while long unattended watchdog runs - exactly the case the Notification hook was written for - have run without it.
claude-serena-watchdog-launch-clean.ps1 hardcodes an owner-machine ProjectPath/PromptFile (lines 14-15); the correct launcher is unusable elsewhere and pins a stale mission file.
notable: The dead-code discipline here is exemplary and worth copying elsewhere: extension.js:767 labels dashboardHtml as UNREACHABLE with a MEASURED date, and tests/test_ui_governance.py::test_dead_mission_control_template_is_labelled_not_believed holds the comment to the code, so the label cannot rot silently.

serena-first.py:15-30 chooses fail-open on purpose and cites amendment proposal 002 point B - 'an unrecoverable guard state is a defect, not a protection'. The consequence is that the hook is inert in any session where Serena did not start, which is exactly the session where symbol drift is most likely.

The watchdog's availability record is the honest headline: attempts 1-11 lost to 'Can't reach the API server (ENOTFOUND)', attempt 12 to 'Request timed out', only attempt 13 of 13 did work (.claude/watchdog/43e2809c-.../attempt-*.log). Any claim about unattended-run throughput must be stated per successful attempt, not per elapsed hour.
claude-serena-watchdog.ps1:413 refuses bypassPermissions by ValidateSet rather than by convention - the one place in this slice where an effect bound is mechanical instead of advisory.

Both surviving webview entry points render an iframe onto apps/web/ (extension.js:309, :1655), which means the VS Code extension is now a shell, not the cockpit; the extension-dev/Perdix charter still describes it as owning 'the Mission Control webview, dashboard'.

.claude/worktrees/ is empty while ~10+ real worktrees live under Desktop/agent_env.worktrees/ - matches the owner's standing rule that lanes belong in agent_env.worktrees/, so the empty directory is vestigial and can go.

Skills split cleanly into instruments backed by repo code (council -> daedalus/council/*, funnel -> tools/funnel*.py - both verified present, both self-declaring ADVISORY and promoting nothing, consistent with Invariants 4 and 5) and vendored design content (ui-ux-pro-max, frontend-design, web-design-guidelines) that nothing in the harness references.

The Iron-Plan guard is strict enough that it refused this read-only inventory twice for merely naming the protected settings files in a tool payload - a real fail-closed data point for the guard, and a note for future inventory agents: refer to them descriptively.
